summary: Iteration 8 — verified iter6 regressions (AI session memory + cart gift-note localStorage persistence) AND the new Stripe Connect Express surface for maker payouts. Backend pytest: 20/20 PASS. Frontend Playwright: cart gift-note persists across reload via cm_gift_note (verified end-to-end), Maker dashboard /maker/dashboard shows Payouts tab with correct state machine (Connect → Resume → Dashboard) — observed payouts-resume-btn after onboard partial flow. Stripe Connect onboard creates real Express test accounts on Stripe dashboard, second call reuses the same acct_id (idempotent, persisted on maker doc). Checkout session injects payment_intent_data.transfer_group and stores it on payment_transactions. The deferred path of transfer_to_makers_for_session correctly writes maker_payouts row with status='deferred' / reason='no-stripe-account' and amount_cents = subtotal*100*0.9 (PLATFORM_FEE_BPS=1000). Auth protection on /maker/stripe/connect/* returns 401 unauth, 403 admin/buyer. iter7 admin regression sweep clean.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_connect.py uses pre_transfer_group from checkout.py (random uuid) but transfer_to_makers_for_session passes transfer_group=session_id to Transfer.create — the PaymentIntent's transfer_group on the charge will NOT match. For Stripe to allow late-binding transfers from charge funds (separate-charge-and-transfer flow with on_behalf_of platform balance), the transfer_group on the Transfer must equal the transfer_group set on the PaymentIntent. Recommend: after Session.create, update the PaymentIntent's transfer_group to session.id, OR change Transfer.create to use the same pre_transfer_group stored on the tx doc. Currently stored as tx['transfer_group'] = pre_transfer_group, so use tx['transfer_group'] in Transfer.create instead of session_id (or re-key the PI).
checkout.py imports stripe_sdk twice (line 82 inline and inside webhook). Minor — consolidate at module top with checkout_status's import.

checkout_status() schedules transfer_to_makers_for_session via bg.add_task on payment_status transition to paid; webhook also calls it directly. Both paths are guarded by maker_payouts.find_one({status: succeeded|pending}) so duplicates are skipped. Good — idempotent.
ai.py replays db.ai_chats history into the system message preamble (max 20 turns). This is the right approach with emergentintegrations LlmChat — verified working: 'fuchsia' recall test passes.
